homeTitle: Preserving the history of pony computing.
homeMeta: Explore an independent archive for My Little Pony-themed operating systems, Linux distributions, and desktop customizations.
catalogMeta: Choose a category to explore reviewed projects, releases, and historical records.
historyMeta: Follow documented releases and project milestones. Dates reflect the precision available in the sources.
contributeMeta: Share project leads, screenshots, documentation, or corrections with the My Little Pony operating systems archive.
aboutMeta: Learn why an independent fan project is preserving the history of My Little Pony-themed operating systems.
heroIntro: An independent archive dedicated to collecting and preserving My Little Pony-themed operating systems, Linux distributions, and desktop customizations.
catalogIntro: From custom kernels to desktop themes, the archive covers three kinds of projects.
independentDescription: Experimental systems and independently developed operating systems with their own kernels.
linuxDescription: Linux-based distributions that bring My Little Pony themes or experiences to the operating system.
desktopDescription: Desktop environments, themes, and visual customizations for existing operating systems.
missionTitle: Preserving a piece of computing history
missionBody: Fan projects can disappear when downloads and project pages go offline. The archive aims to document what was made and preserve the evidence that helps others understand it.
communityBody: Know of a pony-themed operating system, or have an old screenshot or project link? Sharing it can help document a piece of the community’s history.
historyPreserveBody: Discontinued projects, historical releases, screenshots, and surviving documentation can help establish what was built and how it changed.
contributeIntro: Anyone can help document a My Little Pony-themed operating system or desktop project. A link, screenshot, or correction can give the archive a place to start.
aboutIntro: MLP OS Archive is a community-oriented project dedicated to documenting and preserving My Little Pony-themed operating systems and desktop projects.
aboutPreserveBody: Fan-made software is part of computing history. Saving reliable sources, release information, and visual records helps future readers understand how people built and used these projects.
aboutCommunityBody: The archive serves My Little Pony fans and anyone interested in fan-made software. Community members can help by sharing sources, suggesting projects, or correcting records.
disclaimer: This is an unofficial, independently maintained fan project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Hasbro or its subsidiaries.
submissionScope: Projects with independently developed kernels and themed Linux distributions are both welcome.
aboutNonCommercial: The archive is a non-commercial preservation project.
issueBody: Historical, discontinued, unfinished, and experimental projects are welcome. Include the project name, category, a brief description, and at least one reliable source. You can write in the original language. Maintainers review contributions before publication.
pullRequestBody: Add or edit a project record in the repository. Cite the sources, credit any media, and explain the change in your pull request.
categoryEmpty: No reviewed project records in this category yet.
verification-note-unverified: The archive has not yet established the project’s identity or the claims in this record.
verification-note-partially-verified: Sources support some claims. Other details remain uncertain.
verification-note-verified: Reliable evidence supports the project identity and the material claims in this record. First-party records may establish those facts.
verification-note-unable-to-verify: Available evidence was insufficient to corroborate the record.
verificationScope: Archive verification evaluates evidence for the project’s identity and historical record. The status does not certify independent testing on physical hardware.
sharedMaintainerEvidence: {project} and this archive are maintained under the same GitHub account, {account}.
